WITH group_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    eventannotm,
    AVG(instownpct) as group_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
overall_avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM group_avgs
  WHERE group_avg IS NOT NULL
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    g.group_avg,
    oa.overall_avg,
    g.group_avg - oa.overall_avg as difference
  FROM group_avgs g
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_calc oa
  WHERE g.group_avg IS NOT NULL 
    AND oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND g.group_avg > oa.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(group_avg) as avg_group_avg,
  AVG(difference) as avg_difference
FROM pairs
